words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالُ}} ({{tr:al-jibālu}}) is not scenery around the event; its nominative case makes the mountains the passive subject, the thing acted upon. The definite broken plural gathers the known mountain class as a single landscape-scale patient, so the ayah stages fixed terrain before motion reaches it. The root field of {{ar:ج ب ل}} ({{tr:j-b-l}}) supports the image of high solid mass, formed fixity, and anchoring terrain-zone, while the local concrete noun keeps unrelated branches outside the reading. Its weighty sound also lets the mass feel heavy before the lighter moving verb arrives. That is why the pairing with {{ar:سُيِّرَتْ}} ({{tr:suyyirat}}) feels like reversal: what normally anchors the earth is made mobile, in a mountain-displacement network also visible at 18:47, 52:10, 78:20, and 20:105. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The fixed landmark is compelled to travel.** `ج ب ل` B001 supplies a high, massive, solid landmark, and `س ي ر` B001 supplies progression and causing something to move, voluntarily or by compulsion. The passive form and the preceding displaced heavens supply the cue; I infer an external mover. The ayah reads as the reversal of terrestrial fixity, not merely ordinary motion.
2. **Created constitution becomes a changed state.** `ج ب ل` B004 supplies innate formed nature, while `س ي ر` B002 supplies the state or condition something is upon. The packet places this after celestial order fails and before prized livestock is abandoned. I infer that the mountain's normal constitution functions as the baseline being overturned. The ayah can thus read as a transformation of what appeared naturally immovable into a new imposed condition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The wish to become straight in 81:28 unexpectedly reactivated `س ي ر` B002: a thing's “course/state” can be imposed, lost, or deliberately aligned. This did not turn the mountain into a moral agent; it clarified the ayah's reversal of a settled condition.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Fixed mass is converted into compelled process.** `ج ب ل` `B001` supplies the high, solid earth-mass, and `س ي ر` `B001` supplies progression and causing something to move, voluntarily or by compulsion. The structural cue is the passive sequence in 81:1-7, where each subject is reassigned a state it does not ordinarily choose. Solidity plays the role of the baseline that compelled movement reverses. I infer that the passive form foregrounds removal of autonomy rather than ordinary travel. The ayah consequently reads as a category reversal: the land's emblem of fixity is made into transit.

2. **The hard closure of earth is removed.** `ج ب ل` `B005` supplies hardness that stops digging, while `س ي ر` `B005` supplies removing a covering or driving it away. Five ayat later, 81:8 names the living victim weighted under earth through `و ء د` `B001`. That later burial image gives the mountain's hardness the role of an obstructing cover. My abductive move is that moving the mountains also models removal of earth's power to keep testimony closed; the packet supplies hard ground, removal, and burial, but I supply their causal linkage. The ayah then anticipates exposure: even the most resistant terrestrial covering cannot remain over what was hidden.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The buried victim of 81:8 unexpectedly refunctionalized `ج ب ل` `B005` (hardness that stops digging) and `س ي ر` `B005` (removal). Mountain-motion retrospectively became a model of earth losing its ability to seal testimony.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vegetation emerges, thickens, is tended or supported, feeds animals, and renews after rain or harvest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The botanical channel reaches precise practices such as trellising vines, pollinating palms, grazing stubble, and exposing hidden roots.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fertile Rain, Withering, and Renewal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rain-bearing cloud makes soil productive, while dry wood and hidden roots preserve the possibility of return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile land and rain (`ك ر م:B002/m01`); rainfall (`ذ ه ب:B005/m01`); rain cloud (`ر ب ب:B008/m01`); sky or cloud as rain source (`س م و:B004/m02`); dry tree (`ج ب ل:B008/m01`); buried roots (`غ ي ب:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel holds drought and fertility together through a causal sequence of dry plant, rain cloud, productive earth, and surviving root.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The motion vocabulary reconstructs horse handling, caravan gait, races, hunting, and the formation of customary routes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Caravan and Herd Gait
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Animals move in ordered groups with easy joints, successive files, and a steady intermediate gait.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: overland travel (`س ي ر:B001/m01`); travelling caravan (`س ي ر:B006/m01`); easy gait (`ر س ل:B003/m01`); group following group (`ر س ل:B005/m01`); continuous herd movement (`س ج ر:B008/m01`); animals lacking tack (`ع ط ل:B003/m01`); gathered herd (`ك و ر:B003/m01`); heavy footfall (`و ء د:B003/m01`); animal stopping from fatigue (`ق و م:B016/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene coordinates formation, gait, equipment state, and succession rather than treating every movement word as simple travel.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and groups move through directed travel, running, pursuit, dispatch, and patterned routes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The motion vocabulary reconstructs horse handling, caravan gait, races, hunting, and the formation of customary routes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Departure Across the Horizons
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler sets out through distant regions, leaving a former place as fear falls away.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: travel through remote regions (`ء ف ق:B002/m01`); going away (`ذ ه ب:B006/m01`); overland movement (`س ي ر:B001/m01`); entering mountain country (`ج ب ل:B006/m01`); removal or expulsion (`س ي ر:B005/m01`); fear departing (`ك ش ط:B004/m01`); throwing off weight to escape (`و ح ش:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Movement is an exit process: range opens ahead, burdens are cast off, and the traveler leaves both place and panic behind.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and groups move through directed travel, running, pursuit, dispatch, and patterned routes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The motion vocabulary reconstructs horse handling, caravan gait, races, hunting, and the formation of customary routes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Customary Route and Method
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Repeated conduct settles into a recognized way of proceeding.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: established manner (`ج ر ي:B002/m01`); customary way (`س ي ر:B002/m01`); route or method (`ذ ه ب:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Habit, customary conduct, and named route are three scales of the same stabilization of movement into method.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Several sparse constructions assemble complete crafts: leather preparation, patterned textiles, mining and gilding, a fired forge, and necklace work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hide, Pelt, and Tanning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An animal skin is stripped, left with or without hair, cut into thongs, and treated with measured tanning material.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hide under treatment (`ء ف ق:B005/m01`); hide-processing liquor (`ء ف ق:B006/m01`); small tanning dose (`ن ف س:B007/m01`); hair-on pelt (`ص ح ب:B006/m01`); skinning (`ك ش ط:B002/m01`); removed hide covering meat (`ك ش ط:B003/m01`); leather thong (`س ي ر:B003/m01`); dressing compound (`ر ب ب:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene preserves successive craft states: removal, hair retention, cutting, dosing, and chemical dressing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Raw hide, fiber, metal, and mineral are transformed through stripping, tanning, folding, heating, coating, and ornamentation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Several sparse constructions assemble complete crafts: leather preparation, patterned textiles, mining and gilding, a fired forge, and necklace work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Woven, Striped, Folded, and Bundled Cloth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cloth is tightly woven, marked with linear bands, folded, wrapped, and bundled for carrying.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: finished weaving (`ج ب ل:B007/m01`); stripe-like bands (`س ي ر:B004/m01`); first fold of a garment (`ق س م:B007/m01`); clothing bundle (`ك و ر:B007/m01`); wrapped garment (`ك و ر:B008/m01`); howdah drape (`ز و ج:B006/m01`); identifying textile mark (`ع ل م:B002/m03`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Weave, stripe, fold, wrapper, carrying bundle, and drape occupy successive roles in one textile-production and use scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Raw hide, fiber, metal, and mineral are transformed through stripping, tanning, folding, heating, coating, and ornamentation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mine, Gold, and Gilding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Mineral is extracted from a stony source, separated as gold, and applied as a surface coating.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mine or mineral source (`ن ج م:B008/m01`); gold ore or nugget (`ذ ه ب:B001/m01`); stony mass (`ر ج م:B005/m01`); mountain material (`ج ب ل:B001/m01`); gilding or gold plating (`ذ ه ب:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provenance, stone matrix, extracted metal, and coating form a continuous material transformation from mine to finished surface.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech acts organize social attention through questioning, consultation, command, circulation, accusation, and emotional address.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The speech channel includes bargaining, rumor, false attribution, backbiting, invective, lament, and fluency blocked by difficulty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fluency and Speech Blockage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker ranges from abundant fluent expression to being unable to continue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fluent loquacity (`ق و ل:B003/m01`); speech made difficult (`ج ب ل:B009/m01`); hard, forceful articulation (`ذ ك ر:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Loquacity, articulatory force, and blockage define contrasting capacities within one speech-performance frame.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Mental life moves from perception and inner representation through judgment, trust, doubt, dream, and settled decision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network distinguishes knowledge from mastery, belief from calm trust, hidden thought from doctrine, and conjecture from patient deliberation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Patience and Deliberate Resolve
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person slows action, tolerates uncertainty, weighs alternatives, and then resolves to proceed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate slowness (`و ء د:B002/m01`); measured conduct (`ر س ل:B004/m01`); respite for thought (`ن ف س:B015/m01`); divided consideration (`ق س م:B006/m01`); letting dispute pass (`س ي ر:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Slowed gait, temporal room, divided attention, and restraint from argument form a coherent discipline of deliberation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social order is maintained through sovereignty, care of an entrusted domain, recognized rank, delegation, and adjudication.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The authority channel moves from throne and lordship to village rulers, substitutes, guarantors, and litigants before a judge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Throne, Ruler, and Chief
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A ruler occupies an elevated seat and exercises speech that carries institutional force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: royal throne (`ع ر ش:B001/m01`); master or owner (`ر ب ب:B001/m02`); ruling chief or prince (`ق و ل:B004/m01`); leading men likened to mountains (`ج ب ل:B012/m01`); elevation of rank (`س م و:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Elevated seat, recognized title, commanding speech, and eminent supporters define a political court.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on willing, being able, submitting, resisting, being compelled, or voluntarily taking on an obligation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Agency appears as a graded field ranging from easy compliance and capability to taming, coercion, moral deviation, and courageous self-commitment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Compulsion, Taming, and Forced Readiness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Resistance is broken through pressure until a person or animal becomes usable and compliant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: forcing another to act (`ج ب ل:B010/m01`); taming through subjugation (`ق ت ل:B002/m01`); imposed effort (`ط و ع:B004/m01`); restive disposition (`ش م س:B002/m01`); institutional control (`ق و ل:B010/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Force, training, imposed effort, and controlling judgment trace the conversion of resistance into constrained performance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: People become socially organized through companionship, pairing, marriage, care, kinship, collective gathering, and residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The social network includes widow courtship, irrevocable divorce, stepchildren, adult sons, clans, settled villages, and abandoned homes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gathering, Crowd, and Clan
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Individuals are driven together into a crowd, community, clan, or mobilized assembly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering toward a destination (`ح ش ر:B001/m01`); mass of common people (`ج ن ن:B013/m01`); multitude (`ج ب ل:B002/m01`); clan or tribe (`ع ش ر:B013/m01`); community of people (`ق و م:B001/m01`); present group (`ح ض ر:B007/m01`); followers (`ذ ن ب:B003/m01`); confederated groups (`ر ب ب:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mass, lineage, presence, and directed assembly distinguish an organized community from an accidental plurality.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons and things are socially evaluated through reputation, generosity, rivalry, dignity, courage, and their negative reversals.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Honor is not only praise; it also drives competitive boasting, guarded preciousness, ambition, shamelessness, and verbal attack.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dignity, Ambition, and Courage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Inner stature supports high aspiration and the courage to bear difficult action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dignity and aspiration (`ن ف س:B014/m01`); tightly held need or ambition (`ر ب ب:B016/m01`); gathered strength (`ق و ي:B001/m01`); robust constitution (`ج ب ل:B003/m01`); self-endangering courage (`ق ت ل:B012/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Character is embodied as inner magnitude, concentrated need, physical strength, and readiness to act under danger.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The body senses and displays the world through eye, breath, smell, color, stature, tissue, and disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The body channel includes evil eye, intact but blind eye, lung and nostril, complexion, obesity, chest bones, sinews, cleft lip, wasting disease, mange, and cough.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Body Mass, Skeleton, and Sinew
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bodily form is built from compact mass, swollen abdomen, chest bones, hip joint, and tensioned nerves.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: thick bodily build (`ج ب ل:B003/m01`); enlarged abdomen (`ب ح ر:B013/m01`); swollen flanks (`ح ش ر:B005/m01`); chest bones (`ج ن ن:B016/m01`); compact strong body (`ك د ر:B005/m01`); hip joint (`ك ر م:B007/m01`); spread sinews (`ن ش ر:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: External mass and internal articulation are linked through bones, joint, and sinew, giving a structured account of bodily robustness.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalın bir biçim için azık, başka bir biçim için azık arayıp edinme anlamını verir. Üçüncü biçim içinse yalnızca bu kökten türemiş sayıldığı belirtilir; bağımsız bir nesne veya eylem anlamı verilmediğinden dalın anlam çekirdeğine ayrı bir kavram olarak eklenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın kanıtlanmış anlamı azık ve azık edinmedir; üçüncü biçim yalnızca türeyiş notuyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek başına kullanılan biçimlerin azık ve azık edinme anlamlarına dayanır; bağımsız anlamı verilmeyen türemiş ad için yeni bir anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yolculuk veya geçim için hazırlanmış yiyecek ile bu yiyeceği arayıp edinme eylemidir. Bir başka ad yalnızca bu kökten türemiş sayılır; onun bağımsız anlamı kanıtlanmaz.

facets.statement: Nesne anlamı, yolculuk veya geçim için edinilen yiyecektir.
Eylem anlamı, gerekli yiyeceği arayıp elde etmektir.
Bir adın bu kökten türemiş sayıldığı bildirilir, ancak o ad için bağımsız bir anlam açıklanmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortaklaştırılabilecek ek bir içerik yoktur; tek tanıklık azık, azık edinme ve sınırlı bir türeyiş notu verir.

source_details.summary: Tanıklık azık ile onu arayıp edinmeyi açıklar; üçüncü bir ad için yalnızca kökten türeyiş bilgisi verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kanıtlanmış nesne ve eylem anlamlarını birlikte verir, yalnızca türeyiş bilgisi bulunan adı kavrama katmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyecek ve edinme sürecini anlatır; komşu dal bu yiyeceği taşıyan katılanları ve yükleri anlatır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_focus_trace_hermetic.note: Hermetic Focus Trace not requested for this bundle. Rebuild with --include-focus-trace, or --require-focus-trace when reader JSON must be present.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained.
